# 🗺️ Chrome Dashboard Roadmap

This is our product roadmap. It shows what we're working on and what's coming next.

> **Note**: This roadmap is subject to change based on user feedback and priorities.

---

## ✅ v2.0-alpha (Current Release)

**Status**: Released  
**Timeline**: Completed November 2025

### Features Completed

- [x] Modern component-based architecture with BaseComponent/BaseWidget
- [x] Event-driven communication system (EventBus)
- [x] Reactive state management (StateManager)
- [x] Chrome Storage wrapper (StorageManager)
- [x] Multi-panel layout system with gesture support
- [x] Focus Mode with Pomodoro Timer
  - Circular SVG progress visualization
  - Configurable work/break durations
  - Session tracking and statistics
  - Productivity score calculation
  - Daily streak tracking
  - Browser notifications
- [x] Extension Control Widget
  - View all installed extensions
  - Enable/disable extensions
  - Search and filter functionality
- [x] Weather Widget with real-time data
- [x] Digital Clock Widget
- [x] Multi-engine Search Widget (10+ engines)
- [x] AI-powered search integration (ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Perplexity)
- [x] Quick Links bookmark system
- [x] Configurable widget settings system
- [x] Lucide Icons integration
- [x] Tailwind CSS styling
- [x] Vite build system
- [x] pnpm package management

---

## 🎯 How to Contribute to the Roadmap

We welcome community input on our roadmap!

### Vote on Features
- 👍 React to issues with 👍 for features you want
- Comment on roadmap issues with use cases
- Participate in discussions

### Propose New Features
1. Check if feature is already proposed
2. Create a new issue with `feature request` label
3. Describe the feature and use case
4. Community discussion and refinement

### Implement Features
1. Check this roadmap for available features
2. Comment on the issue to claim it
3. Follow [Contributing Guidelines](../CONTRIBUTING.md)
4. Submit PR when ready
